reason: 该插件的核心面向用户功能是作为 DeepSeek Harness 的桌宠插件：在插件端提供“桌宠”设置与任务状态归约并落盘（pet.json），在壳端提供可选的 Electron 集成实现用于显示悬浮宠物窗口与状态卡，因此主要用途为 DSH 插件功能扩展（桌面交互体验）。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桌宠功能，包含设置页与任务状态持久化，并配合 Electron 壳展示状态驱动的悬浮宠物窗口。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a desktop pet feature to DeepSeek Harness with a settings page and task-state persistence, designed to drive a floating pet window in an Electron shell.

capabilities: Writes and reads user-level state files under ~/.dsh (pet status and completion markers)
Runs in DeepSeek Harness as a plugin with host/client routing and settings page logic
Includes an Electron shell integration layer to display and animate an on-screen desktop pet window

reasons.code: Package metadata declares a DSH plugin bundle patch and web client injection, indicating distributed plugin runtime behavior.
Repository documentation states the plugin stores status in ~/.dsh/pet.json, consumes session/task events via a reducer, and exposes completion markers for shell usage.
The tree includes bigfish/ shell integration files (main.js, pet.html/js, assets) that depend on Electron window APIs for a floating desktop pet.
